welcome.title: Welcome to KingPost Connect
welcome.lead: A project is a folder on disk. Everything you import, review and link stays in it.
welcome.samples: The sample project is a small building in your Documents folder (KingPost Sample). Use it to try selection, colours, transparency, views and the other tools.
onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.import: Import a model: put an IFC file in the project folder and press Import in the Explorer.
onboarding.load: Load a revision into the viewer and click elements to see their properties.
onboarding.review: Raise an issue on a selection in Review; it keeps the view you had.
onboarding.compare: Import the model again after it changes and compare the revisions.
settings.title: Settings
settings.author: Your name
settings.author.hint: Recorded on issues, comments, statuses, links and markups.
settings.updates.startup: Check for a new version when the application starts
settings.updates.privacy: Nothing is sent except the request for the release list. No check runs unless you ask for it or turn this on.
settings.cache.hint: Opened models are kept in the project's .kingpost/cache folder so they open faster next time.
settings.logs.hint: Logs are written to the project's .kingpost/logs folder. A bundle collects them with the application and project details for support; nothing is sent anywhere.
help.title: Help
help.guide: The user guide is in docs/user-guide.md in the repository and installed next to the application.
